blocks.content:
The CAG submits audit reports to:
• President (for Union accounts)
• Governor (for State accounts)

These reports are then placed before Parliament or State Legislature and examined by the Public Accounts Committee (PAC).

items: CAG reports are NOT submitted directly to Parliament; Union reports are submitted to the President, and State reports to the Governor.
The Public Accounts Committee (PAC) examines the CAG audit reports after they are presented in Parliament or State Legislature.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CAG submits audit reports for Union accounts to the President.
The CAG submits audit reports for State accounts to the Governor.
The submitted reports are placed before Parliament or the respective State Legislature.
The Public Accounts Committee (PAC) is responsible for examining these audit reports.
